title: AION 2 Chanter Guide: Starting Skills and Party Roles
description: Start an AION 2 Chanter with practical skill priorities, mantras, Dark Crush timing, and support adjustments for parties with or without a Cleric.
summary: Build a working melee support setup, prioritize useful mantras, and change damage or recovery options to fit your party and unlocked skills.

topic.alt: Official AION 2 artwork of the Chanter class
topic.caption: Official Chanter class artwork. It illustrates the class identity; the starting setup below is a player's example, not a pictured skill screen.

workflow.title: Practice one Dark Crush window
workflow.caption: Based on aLuckyRO's lower-level demonstration. Only repeat steps that match your selected options and current tooltip.

steps.label: Read the trigger
steps.description: Check the selected Dark Crush option and the condition that makes the follow-up available.

steps.label: Test one opening attack
steps.description: Try a demonstrated trigger such as Rushing Smash and watch whether the opportunity appears.

steps.label: Use the available follow-up
steps.description: Execute the eligible attacks instead of assuming every later-build repetition is unlocked.

steps.label: Fill the gap and react
steps.description: Use ordinary attacks while waiting; interrupt the loop for movement, healing, or protection.
